Adverse Events, Dose reduction and Treatment Discontinuation in Treated Patients.* Peg- IFN: peginterferon, RBV: ribavirin, AE: adverse event, ALT: alanine aminotransferase, ULN: upper limit of normal. *Values are numbers (percentages). †Weight-based RBV arm: major depression at week 8 of treatment, and anxiety disorder at week 7 of treatment, respectively.
